description: This PHP class 'FormatWithJobTitle' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides functionality to fetch and format a job title based on an entity value, typically an ID. It depends on 'JobTitleService' to retrieve 'JobTitle' entities and extracts the job title name if available.

classes.name: FormatWithJobTitle
classes.description: A class that retrieves and formats job titles based on an entity value, utilizing the JobTitleService.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the JobTitleService instance.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Fetches the JobTitle entity by ID and returns its name, or null if not found or invalid.
